3 hours ago
S&P 500 Futures Slip After Monday Record Close
U.S. equity futures moved mostly lower Tuesday, with Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.3% and S&P 500 futures off 0.7%. Both indexes had notched fresh all-time highs the prior session. The Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting also commenced Tuesday.
6 hours ago
Brent Crude Surges Past $104 Amid Iran Strait Doubts
Oil extended its climb Tuesday after Washington signaled skepticism toward Tehran's proposal to halt Strait of Hormuz ship attacks in exchange for a ceasefire. Brent July futures topped $104 per barrel, while June contracts rose above $111.
1 hour ago
April Consumer Confidence Ticks Higher to 92.8
The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index rose 0.6 points to 92.8 in April, up from an upwardly revised 92.2 in March, according to data released Tuesday.
